design:south_node.prompt_template: Thinking about the recurring environments, people, activities, and situations that formed the background of your earlier life, how often did they repeatedly center on {theme_clause}?
design:south_node.measurement_note: Ask for repeated environmental patterns rather than personality self-description.

design:north_node.prompt_template: As your adult life has developed, especially toward midlife and beyond if applicable, how often have your recurring environments, people, activities, and situations increasingly centered on {theme_clause}?
design:north_node.measurement_note: If the later-life phase is not yet observable, use Not yet observable rather than guessing.

personality:south_node.prompt_template: In the earlier part of your life, how often was your attention or way of interpreting what happened repeatedly drawn toward {theme_clause}?
personality:south_node.measurement_note: Measure recurring perspective or what the person notices, not whether they possess the trait.

personality:north_node.prompt_template: As your adult life has developed, especially toward midlife and beyond if applicable, how often has your way of seeing situations increasingly been drawn toward {theme_clause}?
personality:north_node.measurement_note: If the later-life phase is not yet observable, use Not yet observable rather than guessing.

response_scale.label: Not yet observable for my life stage

shared_followups: Describe the recurring pattern rather than a single memorable event.
Which parts were stable across different places or relationships, and which were context-specific?
Give a representative example and a counterexample.
If none of the fixed choices captures it accurately, use Other and describe the nuance.
scientific_separation_rule: This layer may be reported as secondary environment/perspective recovery only. It must not be silently merged into the primary natal trait/behavior score.
